configuration.source: Ali Rogers varian-6mv ideal point z=-100 cm, uniform aiming square 4x4 cm at z=0
configuration.brass: experimental Cu70/Zn30 mass fractions, 8.5 g/cm3; EPDL/EEDL; G4 mixture I and density effect; not independently material-validated
configuration.normalization: absolute MeV/g per emitted photon; no rescaling
configuration.uncertainty: 128 independent 10000000-history batches; SEM after within-batch ROI integration; open-slit only
configuration.note: Dose cross section averaged over water depth 2–4 cm; x=0.1 mm, y=5 mm; production defaults unchanged
configuration.legacy_template_uncertainty: independent 1M-history chunks; paired open/closed chunks within backend
configuration.scored_energy_note: water_deposited in per-batch records is energy in the cropped scoring slab, not all water

precision.definition: Estimated relative 1-sigma standard error of mean dose, from independent batches; not a systematic-accuracy bound or simultaneous confidence interval.
precision.roi: Centers |x|<=6 mm and |y|<=20 mm; 121x8 bins; no dose-threshold exclusion; all five peaks and valleys included; depth 2–4 cm averaged.
precision.outside_roi: No <1% claim outside the predeclared ROI. No smoothing or data clipping.

provenance.normalization: Per primary upstream of the collimator, not per transmitted photon
provenance.material_profile: Experimental Cu70/Zn30; no new transport changes in this study
